fixFailed: The fix could not be applied
fixStale: The job has changed since it was checked. Wait for the new check, then try the fix again.

add.hasErrors: Not added to the queue: the job has an error
add.checking: The job is still being checked. Try again in a moment.
add.unchecked: The job could not be checked, so it was not added. Try again when the server answers.
add.uncheckedLine: its settings could not be checked
add.edit: The output name could not be updated: {reason}
add.editLine: its output name could not be updated: {reason}
add.noPath: The job has no output path.

group.perFileDetail: The group's template cannot hold it, so nothing was changed. Switch the scope to “This file only” to change it for the shown file.
group.trackListPerFile: Tracks are added, removed and moved for the whole group
group.trackListPerFileDetail: Nothing was changed. To use another track or no track in one file, pick it in the matrix.
group.notForGroupDetail: This value is set per file: the group's template cannot hold it.
group.nearMember: {file}'s tracks do not match the group's
group.nearMemberDetail: Nothing was changed. The group's tracks still follow the defaults, so an edit here would make the group's tracks from {file} alone, and the other files would lose the tracks it does not have. Show {representative} to edit the group's tracks.
group.editFailed: An edit did not reach the group
group.detectionFailed: The crop of the group's files could not be detected
group.sourceStale: A file of the group changed on disk since it was opened: remove it from the sources and open it again.
